query:
SELECT mp.id, mp.userId, mp.university, mp.major, mp.field, mp.region, 
       mp.isActive, mp.verificationStatus, u.name, u.email
FROM mentor_profiles mp
INNER JOIN users u ON mp.userId = u.id
WHERE mp.verificationStatus = 'approved';
